provider: Rollin Host Drive empresarial / Backup & Storage (Brazil) — flat per-TB, no request or traffic charge, Pix/boleto

free_tier.stated: Topázio 1 TB R$79.90/mo; Esmeralda 5 TB R$199.90/mo; Diamante 10 TB R$379.90/mo. Monthly cycle, no lock-in («sem fidelidade»), Brazilian NF-e invoice, ceiling 10 TB then sales contact.

egress.terms: FREE, stated twice and unambiguously: «Preço fixo por capacidade — sem cobrança por upload, download ou requisição» (fixed price per capacity — no charge for upload, download or request) and repeated per plan as «Sem cobrança de tráfego». The FAQ confirms it is not S3-compatible: «não é object storage S3-compatible».

tooling: SFTP, Samba/CIFS, WebDAV; explicitly documented as working with BorgBackup, Restic, rsync, rclone and Duplicati. Mounts as a network drive on Windows and macOS. Automatic read-only snapshots for ransomware rollback.
chaining: Three fixed capacities; 20 TB would need sales contact (they say «Precisa de mais de 10 TB? Fale com a gente»). Two 10 TB plans = 20 TB at the same rate if they will sell it.
limits_note: Brazilian datacentre only — for a non-Brazilian client every byte is intercontinental, which makes the 500 GB-1 TiB/day serving workload uneconomic regardless of the zero egress price. Not S3, so no presigned-URL path to Cloudflare. Stripe of the product is backup/archive, not a CDN origin.
reliability_note: Small Brazilian host; the product is explicitly positioned as backup storage («Não é uma suíte de documentos colaborativos: é o arquivo central da empresa»). No independent benchmark exists. Payment friction is low for a Brazilian buyer (Pix, boleto, card in 12×) and moderate for a foreign one (card only, BRL FX).
